references.text: Moses cries out to the Lord on behalf of the people when they complain, a recurring pattern during the wilderness journey
Moses intercedes for the people and the Lord spares them from His wrath
Moses prays to the Lord for another person, demonstrating his role as an intercessor
Moses intercedes for the people of Israel when God intends to punish them
Moses and Aaron fall down and pray for the people when God's anger is kindled
The people ask Moses to intercede, and the Lord answers his prayer
Moses recalls his intercessions for the people that saved them from the Lord's wrath
Moses is mentioned as one of those who called on the name of the Lord and received an answer
The prayer of a righteous person has great power, illustrated through prophetic intercession
